adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6`, the diff removes `afterModel` (which previously returned `model.findMembers()` and thus let the route wait on the async fetch) and instead calls `model.findMembers();` inside `setupController` without returning/awaiting it. Given `findMembers` is async (AJAX) and populates `members` only in its `.then(...)` (see `discourse/models/group.js`), the members template (`group/members.hbs`) can render before `members` is set/updated, causing an initial empty render and potentially showing prior/stale `members` until the request completes.
